route: gpt-6-luna (assigned model; no separate runtime route telemetry exposed)

evidence.observation: Explicit context-scouting limitations, stage separation, product-workflow guide, and MCP boundaries are summarized and linked to detailed sources.
Direct lookup is preferred for known/small tasks; delegation overhead is acknowledged; outputs are verified by the main agent; unsupported/cancelled cases and savings limits are documented.

Existing batching, bounded exact reads, reuse constraints, recheck inheritance and serial pending-only progression are documented alongside integrity, independent review and recovery requirements. Status polling is removed only from the uninterrupted acknowledged serial advancement path; status remains on recovery/concurrency paths.
Snapshot identity and runtime verification are separated from build success; installation/update/rollback instructions retain explicit backups and verification steps.
Export/check and installed runtime are distinguished; pinned-provider verification scope and untested native UI/model integration are disclosed.
Prior qualification is explicitly scoped as P03, P04 not started; descriptive fixture counts and sample sizes are reported, with scripted semantic-review and general live-speedup limits.

Native captures identify model/settings and distinguish elapsed wall time from tool intervals, unavailable reasoning/model-stage measures and simulations; failed evidence and platform exclusions remain visible.
Historical Codex qualification is distinguished from cancelled Claude live qualification; simulations are not runtime passes and savings are explicitly unmeasured.
The dated provider source check establishes provider loading behavior only, not UI or end-to-end model execution.

limitations: Read-only documentation and selected evidence review only; no audited skills, scenarios, generators, installs, builds, or tests were executed, per protocol.
No live managed YAML was parsed and no scenario MCP capability was needed for the assigned documentation/evidence scope.
The reviewed benchmark documents are retained historical artifacts; this audit did not rerun or independently revalidate their measurements.
Coverage is limited to the explicitly assigned existing-workflow documentation and measurement-evidence components; it is not a whole-repository audit.
